Dozens of pictorial stories—told in wood carvings, painting, or pyrography—adorn every outer surface of this _+1 [resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=279) [wooden breastplate](/Armor.aspx?ID=36)_. All are old, and many truly ancient, depicting tales set eons ago on the [Plane of Wood](/Planes.aspx?ID=25). You gain a +2 item bonus to [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) checks to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26). If you know the [_collective memories_](/Rituals.aspx?ID=15) ritual, you can use Nature instead of [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) if you're the primary caster.

**Activate—Statue Disguise** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The armor makes you look like a wooden statue version of one of the creatures depicted on the armor for 1 hour. This is a 3rd-rank [_illusory disguise_](/Spells.aspx?ID=159), but it can make you look like any creature depicted on the armor. This doesn't change your size or the capabilities of your body, and it scales the appearance of the creature to match yours. You can Dismiss the activation. This disguise is just real enough to make you somewhat closer to a creature of wood. You're affected by two spells while it lasts: [_oaken resilience_](/Spells.aspx?ID=20) and [_speak with plants_](/Spells.aspx?ID=294). If you stand still, you gain a +2 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) checks and DCs to appear as an inanimate wooden statue, in addition to the status bonus to Deception from _illusory disguise_.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 224

**Price** 700 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Light always seems to be refracting through this simple prism, creating a hazy multicolor aura that surrounds the glass. When exposed to direct sunlight, the prism radiates a beam of light that shifts in color. This beam spells out the name of the jann shuyookh for whom the prism was designed. While holding the prism to your eye, your vision becomes overwhelmed with colors that guide your eye, granting you a +2 item bonus to visual Perception checks. If you look through the prism while you Seek, you can scan or search an area twice as large as normal (a 60-foot cone, 30-foot burst, or 20-foot square) as the varying colors help you distinguish between your surroundings.

**Activate—Jann's Light** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You raise the prism above your head and call upon the jann shuyookh to come to your aid. The shuyookh's face becomes visible in a reflection in the prism and light shines out from the prism, surrounding you in a multitude of colors. For 1 minute, you shed [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) in a 20-foot emanation (and [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408) for the next 20 feet). The light coruscates with two colors chosen by the jann, and you gain resistance 5 to two damage types based on the colors chosen: **red** [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), **orange** [acid](/Traits.aspx?ID=3), **yellow** [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56), **green** [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), **blue** [sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147), **indigo** [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), or **violet** [force](/Traits.aspx?ID=75).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts **Source** [Pathfinder #196: The Summer That Never Was](/Sources.aspx?ID=214) pg. 81 **Price** 100 gp **Usage** worn cloak **Bulk** L --- While [Yaezhing](/Deities.aspx?ID=184) is feared and seldom worshipped in the open, some regions of Tian Xia see him as a god of necessary evil and their only hope for justice. This garment is often worn by bounty hunters or priests of Yaezhing, yet non-worshippers of the god of harsh justice sometimes wear this item without fear of religious persecution. The red cape appears almost black while in the shadows, with a lighter red mandala pattern on it that resembles a shuriken. When you invest a _cape of justice_, you must designate a single creature as your offender. You must have met the creature before, or the creature should have a persona well known to the public (for instance, a bandit's epithet, if not their face as shown on a wanted poster). You gain a +1 item bonus to [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=53) this creature. If you don't designate a creature as your offender when you invest the _cape of justice_, or if 24 hours pass without you either slaying or capturing your offender, your thoughts become worried and distracted and you take a –1 item penalty to Perception checks for the next 24 hours. **Activate** command, Interact ([force](/Traits.aspx?ID=75)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Effect** By using a free hand to grab the edge of your cape and give it a quick flourish, you cause a red, shuriken-shaped bolt of force to fire at a target within 60 feet that you can see. The shuriken hits automatically and deals 1d4+1 force damage, or 2d4+2 force damage if the target is your designated offender. If the target is within 30 feet, you can attempt to Demoralize the target as a free action after the shuriken strikes them. **Activate** command, Interact ([incapacitation](/Traits.aspx?ID=93)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You produce [manacles](/Equipment.aspx?ID=32) from the cape and then fling them at a Medium or Small bipedal target within 30 feet. The target must attempt a DC 18 Reflex save. **Critical Success** The target is unaffected, and the manacles vanish.
**Success** The manacles strike the target's legs but fail to latch properly. The target is [flat-footed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=16) until the start of your next turn, at which point the manacles vanish.
**Failure** The manacles lock on the target's legs, causing the target to take a –15-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 minute, or until it [Escapes](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) or is freed by someone using [Pick a Lock](/Actions.aspx?ID=70) (DC 18), after which the manacles vanish.
**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target is [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=24) for as long as the manacles remain in place.

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</column>

---

Given as thanks for honoring the memories of three unfortunate travelers who met a tragic end in the Willowshore Hinterlands, this red-hooded cloak is decorated with an image of an elaborately dressed performer whose two companions hold a lantern and umbrella for her.

**Activate** <actions string="Three Actions" /> command, envision, Interact ([evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=100)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You don't have the umbrella activation of this cloak active; **Effect** With a wave of the cloak to the left, you cause the image of the lantern-holding companion on the cloak to vanish. A floating red lantern appears at your side and follows you at an arm's length while casting [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) in a 20-foot radius (and [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408) for the next 20 feet) like a [torch](/Equipment.aspx?ID=60). For 1 hour, while the light from this lantern is active, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks. You can Activate the cloak again to dismiss the torch.

**Activate** <actions string="Three Actions" /> command, envision, Interact ([abjuration](/Traits.aspx?ID=2)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You don't have the lantern activation of this cloak active; **Effect** With a wave of the cloak to the right, you cause the image of the umbrella-holding companion on the cloak to vanish. An indestructible red wax paper umbrella appears above you and follows you, shielding you from weather effects, such as rain or bright sunlight. For 1 hour, while this umbrella is active, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) checks. You can Activate the cloak again to dismiss the umbrella.

</column>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Necromancy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=117" />
<trait label="Tattoo" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=262" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #196: The Summer That Never Was](/Sources.aspx?ID=214) pg. 82

**Price** 60 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** tattooed on the body

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The _spider lily tattoo_ marks you as a trusted member of Granny Hu's network. This crimson tattoo fades and becomes invisible within a day of being applied, reappearing only when you Activate it, when you gain the [doomed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=9) condition, or when you die. The higher the doomed value, the more vivid the color. If your tattoo is plainly visible, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) checks against all creatures that can see the tattoo, but you take a –1 item penalty to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks to [Make an Impression](/Actions.aspx?ID=50) on those who understand the actual meaning of the _spider lily tattoo_ (including all of Willowshore's citizens).

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32))   **Requirements** Your tattoo isn't currently visible; **Effect** You make the tattoo visible. You can use this activation again to make the tattoo not visible, unless you have the doomed condition.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** An [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) creature detects you for the first time;  **Effect** The _spider lily tattoo_ manipulates your life force to make you appear to be undead for a short time. Attempt a [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) check against the triggering undead creature's Perception DC. On a success, the triggering undead believes you're undead as well—a [mindless](/Traits.aspx?ID=108) undead is likely to ignore you, while a sapient undead might react with curiosity or confusion. You can continue attempting Deception checks each round as a single action to Sustain the effect for up to 1 minute.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

Rippling water motifs decorate this simple suit of _+1 [resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=279) [full plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=13)_. The plate has been altered for underwater use, so it's check penalty doesn't apply to Acrobatics or Athletics checks in water or similar liquids. While wearing the armor, you gain a +2 item bonus to Athletics checks to [Swim](/Actions.aspx?ID=39), and you can breathe underwater. 

**Activate—Ride the Waves** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** The ripples on the armor begin to undulate, matching the movement of any nearby water. The armor casts [_water walk_](/Spells.aspx?ID=371) on you. 

**Activate—Submerge** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104), [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=127))
 **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You merge with the water for 10 minutes. While merged, you can't move, you can see through the water if it's clear enough, and you can hear what's going on outside of the water. Water typically can't take damage, but if the water you're merged in is subject to electricity damage or an ability or effect that destroys or dries water, you're expelled from the water and take 10d6 damage. [_Control water_](/Spells.aspx?ID=51) expels you without dealing damage.

---

Etchings of powerful bears decorate these brass bracers. You gain a +3 item bonus to Athletics checks and a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to lift a heavy object, [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79), and [Force Open](/Actions.aspx?ID=34). When you invest the bracers, you either increase your Strength modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value. 

**Activate—Bear Hug** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** Attempt to [Grapple](/Actions.aspx?ID=35) a creature. If you succeed, you crush the creature in your grasp, dealing bludgeoning damage to it equal to your Strength modifier. If you critically succeeded, the damage is equal to double your Strength modifier and the creature [suffocates](/Rules.aspx?ID=2439) as long as it remains grabbed or restrained by you.

This is a healing effect. The medicines can't be used to treat the same affliction for that patient again.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 276

**Price** 22,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hand

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

An array of semiprecious stones is set into the ornate silver and beaten copper cover of this thick and weighty tome. If you open the book before it's been activated, its vellum pages are blank and pristine, but once activated, words dance and swim onto the pages before your eyes. 

**Activate—Skim** <actions string="" /> 10 minutes ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** As you flip through the book, you think about a broad topic you want to know more about. Choose one skill: Arcana, Crafting, Medicine, Nature, Occultism, Religion, Society, or a single subcategory of Lore. The book's pages fill with information about that skill, though only you can see the information. While the pages are full, you can spend an Interact action perusing the book just before attempting a check to Recall Knowledge with the chosen skill. This grants you a +3 item bonus to the check, and if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead. The information within the book disappears after 24 hours or when the tome is activated again.  

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

A grinning skull tops the bow of this macabre key. This key can be used in place of a thieves' toolkit when attempting to [Pick a Lock](/Actions.aspx?ID=70), and it grants a +1 item bonus to the Thievery check. If the skeleton key becomes broken due to a critical failure on the check, it works as a normal thieves' toolkit and loses its benefits until repaired. 

**Activate—Loosen Lock** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The key casts [_knock_](/Spells.aspx?ID=168) on the lock you're trying to pick.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Arcane" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=534" />
<trait label="Focused" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=609" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn garment

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Although not all wizards have gone through formal training, it's become tradition to enchant robes representing the arduous training required and festoon them with honors one has earned. Typically, an _accolade robe_ is styled after a single wizard school, with appropriate colors and symbols. Wearing these robes grants a +2 item bonus to Arcana checks.

 The pockets of the robe tie to an extradimensional space that can hold 1 Bulk of items, none of which can have greater than light Bulk. The items must be related to spellcasting and academics—spellbooks, scrolls, wands, scholarly journals, and other academic supplies the GM allows. These items do not count against your Bulk limit. You can Interact to retrieve or stow items normally. 

**Activate—Review** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** You retrieve an item of your choice from the robe's storage, then Recall Knowledge. 

**Activate—Extra Credit** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can spend only to cast a school spell. If you don't spend this Focus Point by the end of this turn, it is lost.

**Craft Requirements** You are a wizard of the associated school.

markdown:
**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Usage** worn --- Over millennia, these mysterious, intricately cut gemstones have been hoarded by mystics and fanatics hoping to discover their secrets. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to construct the universe in primeval times.
When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an _aeon stone_ with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful Disarm action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are suppressed until you return it to orbit your head again.
There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into a special magical item called a [_wayfinder_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=470) Aeon Stone (Amplifying) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 9,750 gp --- An _amplifying aeon stone_ must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +2 item bonus to Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion checks—whichever corresponds to the tradition of the last spell you enhanced with this aeon stone. **Activate—Amplify** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [spellshape](/Traits.aspx?ID=513)) **Effect** If your next action is to Cast a Spell, that spell's rank is 1 higher (maximum 10th rank) for the purposes of counteracting and being counteracted. Aeon Stone (Consumed) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 9 gp --- A _consumed aeon stone_ is a dull lump that has lost its magical properties. It still rotates your head like any other aeon stone and can thus serve as a stylish, hand-free option for various spells that target an object. This _aeon stone_ has no resonant power. Aeon Stone (Delaying) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 350 gp --- When you would die from the dying condition (typically at dying 4), this smooth pink stone automatically activates and reduces your dying value to 1 less than would normally kill you (typically to dying 3). The stone then permanently turns into a _consumed aeon stone_. You can benefit from this ability only once per day, even if you have multiple such stones.
The resonant power allows you to cast 1st-rank [_heal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=148) as a divine innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Envisioning) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 425 gp --- This clear cube allows you to communicate with a limited form of telepathy to a range of 100 feet. The messages are transmitted as a simple image each round. These images are the quality of a hasty or childish sketch but can be roughly understood by creatures regardless of language. This provides no special ability to respond to your images.
The resonant power allows you to cast [_translate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1723) as an occult innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Peering) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 9,500 gp --- This faintly colored prism catches and transforms light. If the _aeon stone_ is in an area of bright light, shades of purple light provide dim light in a 30-foot radius. In that radius, magical items and effects are tinged with purple, the depth of the color revealing their [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) rank.
The GM also secretly rolls a counteract check against any darkness or illusion effect the light touches. It has a counteract modifier of +25. If the light fails to counteract an effect, it won't try again for 24 hours.
Inside a _wayfinder_, the aeon stone cannot catch light. However, its resonant power lets you activate or deactivate the aeon stone's light emitting from the _wayfinder_ as an Interact action. Aeon Stone (Nourishing) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 325 gp --- After you've invested and worn this transparent stone for a week continuously, you no longer need to eat or drink. This time resets if you remove the _aeon stone_ or it's invested by someone else. The resonant power allows you to cast [_air bubble_](/Spells.aspx?ID=5) as a primal innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Preserving) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 150 gp --- This red crystalline star covers you in a faint aura when you are subject to lingering wounds. You gain resistance 3 to [persistent damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). At the end of any turn where the persistent damage can't overcome this resistance, end that condition.
The resonant power allows you to cast [_stabilize_](/Spells.aspx?ID=307) as a primal innate cantrip. Aeon Stone (Smoothing) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 310 gp --- This spherical piece of silvery stone helps you ignore minor issues. You can ignore status penalties to skill checks from [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=3), [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13), [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19), [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34), and [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37) conditions as long as the value of that condition is 1. Its resonant power allows you to cast [_guidance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=142) as an occult innate cantrip. Aeon Stone (Sprouting) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 220 gp --- Encouraging the natural growth of life, this green ovoid can often be found surrounded by new seedlings. Its resonant power allows you to cast [_tangle vine_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1713) as a primal innate cantrip. **Activate—Flow of Life** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [vitality](/Traits.aspx?ID=509)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You are healed by a vitality efect or took void damage; **Effect** You gain 8 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute. Aeon Stone (Formulating) **Source** [Pathfinder #213: Thirst for Blood](/Sources.aspx?ID=257) pg. 81 **Price** 75 gp --- This four-sided prism is imbued with knowledge for the construction of several objects. The stone contains the knowledge of all formulas found in a basic crafter’s book. While you have the stone [invested](/Traits.aspx?ID=637), you have the full knowledge of the stone’s formulas. This counts as having the formula for the purposes of [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=37) checks. While you have this knowledge, you can write the formulas down for later use, such as if you lose access to the stone. You also gain a +1 item bonus to skill checks made to [Craft](/Actions.aspx?ID=2385) while the stone is invested. The resonant power allows you to cast [_phantasmal minion_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1631) as an arcane innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Repairing) **Source** [Pathfinder #213: Thirst for Blood](/Sources.aspx?ID=257) pg. 82 **Price** 75 gp --- This translucent, spherical stone’s center contains a multitude of sparkling, colored flecks. While you have this stone [invested](/Traits.aspx?ID=637), you gain a +1 item bonus to skill checks made to Craft. Additionally, when Repairing an item, you restore an additional 5 Hit Points to the item (10 Hit Points on a critical success). The resonant power allows you to cast [_mending_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1597) as an arcane innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Crescent) **Source** [Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun](/Sources.aspx?ID=259) pg. 79 **Price** 225 gp --- Once holy relics, the creation of _crescent aeon stones_ was inspired by [Acavna](/Deities.aspx?ID=402), goddess of the moon and protection. The _crescent aeon stone_ continually sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius. The resonant power enables you to cast [_forbidding ward_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1535) as a [divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2) innate cantrip. **Activate—Moonbeam** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=579), [holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=640), [spirit](/Traits.aspx?ID=737)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The crescent aeon stone fires a blast of silvery moonlight in a 100-foot [line](/Rules.aspx?ID=2388), dealing 4d12 spirit damage to all creatures in the area (DC 22 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save). This is [silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2920) damage for the purposes of weaknesses, resistances, and the like. Aeon Stone (Vital amplification) **Source** [Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun](/Sources.aspx?ID=259) pg. 79 **Price** 330 gp --- A _vital amplification aeon stone_ improves the flow of vital energy through your body, speeding the healing process and safeguarding your body from life-draining effects. Whenever you regain Hit Points, you regain an additional 1 Hit Point for each 10 Hit Points regained (minimum 1 additional Hit Point). The resonant power grants you [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) 5 to void damage. Aeon Stone (Flickering) **Source** [Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun](/Sources.aspx?ID=259) pg. 79 **Price** 1,200 gp --- A _flickering aeon stone_ contains a drop of orichalcum at its center. It remains slightly out of phase with reality, giving it a translucent appearance. **Activate—Flicker** ; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The _flickering aeon stone_ draws you slightly out of sync with the flow of time, causing you to flicker in and out of existence. You become [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) for 1 minute, but you can’t use this concealment to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) or [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=2405). **Activate—Enter Stasis** ; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The _flickering aeon stone_ pulls you from the flow of time completely, placing you in temporary stasis while you heal, then returning you to reality at the moment you left. You regain 2d10+8 Hit Points. If you have the [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61), [drained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68), [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71), or [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) condition, the value of each of these conditions is reduced by 1. The resonant power grants you a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls. Aeon Stone (Eastern Star) **Source** [The Dead God's Hand](/Sources.aspx?ID=370) pg. 143 **Price** 350 gp --- This red crystal is cut in the shape of a five-pointed star. An _eastern star aeon stone_ must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +1 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) checks. **Activate—Absorb Language** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You touch a creature who spoke a common language in your presence within the previous minute. The _eastern star aeon stone_ becomes infused with this language, granting you the ability to understand, speak, and write that language. This activation persists until you activate it again. Aeon Stone (Western Star) **Source** [The Dead God's Hand](/Sources.aspx?ID=370) pg. 143 **Price** 150 gp --- This blue crystal is cut in the shape of a five-pointed star. A _western star aeon stone_ must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +1 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38) checks. **Activate—Illusory Disguise** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The _western star aeon stone_ casts a 1st-rank [illusory disguise](/Spells.aspx?ID=1568) to your specifications. If you so choose, the disguise obscures any _aeon stones_ orbiting your head, rendering them [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=83) until the activation ends.

Aeon Stone (Consumed) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 9 gp --- A _consumed aeon stone_ is a dull lump that has lost its magical properties. It still rotates your head like any other aeon stone and can thus serve as a stylish, hand-free option for various spells that target an object. This _aeon stone_ has no resonant power. Aeon Stone (Delaying) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 350 gp --- When you would die from the dying condition (typically at dying 4), this smooth pink stone automatically activates and reduces your dying value to 1 less than would normally kill you (typically to dying 3). The stone then permanently turns into a _consumed aeon stone_. You can benefit from this ability only once per day, even if you have multiple such stones.
The resonant power allows you to cast 1st-rank [_heal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=148) as a divine innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Envisioning) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 425 gp --- This clear cube allows you to communicate with a limited form of telepathy to a range of 100 feet. The messages are transmitted as a simple image each round. These images are the quality of a hasty or childish sketch but can be roughly understood by creatures regardless of language. This provides no special ability to respond to your images.
The resonant power allows you to cast [_translate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1723) as an occult innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Peering) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 9,500 gp --- This faintly colored prism catches and transforms light. If the _aeon stone_ is in an area of bright light, shades of purple light provide dim light in a 30-foot radius. In that radius, magical items and effects are tinged with purple, the depth of the color revealing their [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) rank.
The GM also secretly rolls a counteract check against any darkness or illusion effect the light touches. It has a counteract modifier of +25. If the light fails to counteract an effect, it won't try again for 24 hours.
Inside a _wayfinder_, the aeon stone cannot catch light. However, its resonant power lets you activate or deactivate the aeon stone's light emitting from the _wayfinder_ as an Interact action. Aeon Stone (Nourishing) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 325 gp --- After you've invested and worn this transparent stone for a week continuously, you no longer need to eat or drink. This time resets if you remove the _aeon stone_ or it's invested by someone else. The resonant power allows you to cast [_air bubble_](/Spells.aspx?ID=5) as a primal innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Preserving) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 150 gp --- This red crystalline star covers you in a faint aura when you are subject to lingering wounds. You gain resistance 3 to [persistent damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). At the end of any turn where the persistent damage can't overcome this resistance, end that condition.
The resonant power allows you to cast [_stabilize_](/Spells.aspx?ID=307) as a primal innate cantrip. Aeon Stone (Smoothing) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 310 gp --- This spherical piece of silvery stone helps you ignore minor issues. You can ignore status penalties to skill checks from [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=3), [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13), [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19), [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34), and [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37) conditions as long as the value of that condition is 1. Its resonant power allows you to cast [_guidance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=142) as an occult innate cantrip. Aeon Stone (Sprouting) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 220 gp --- Encouraging the natural growth of life, this green ovoid can often be found surrounded by new seedlings. Its resonant power allows you to cast [_tangle vine_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1713) as a primal innate cantrip. **Activate—Flow of Life** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [vitality](/Traits.aspx?ID=509)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You are healed by a vitality efect or took void damage; **Effect** You gain 8 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute. Aeon Stone (Formulating) **Source** [Pathfinder #213: Thirst for Blood](/Sources.aspx?ID=257) pg. 81 **Price** 75 gp --- This four-sided prism is imbued with knowledge for the construction of several objects. This counts as having the formula for the purposes of [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=37) checks. While you have this knowledge, you can write the formulas down for later use, such as if you lose access to the stone. You also gain a +1 item bonus to skill checks made to [Craft](/Actions.aspx?ID=2385) while the stone is invested. The resonant power allows you to cast [_phantasmal minion_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1631) as an arcane innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Repairing) **Source** [Pathfinder #213: Thirst for Blood](/Sources.aspx?ID=257) pg. 82 **Price** 75 gp --- This translucent, spherical stone’s center contains a multitude of sparkling, colored flecks. While you have this stone [invested](/Traits.aspx?ID=637), you gain a +1 item bonus to skill checks made to Craft. Additionally, when Repairing an item, you restore an additional 5 Hit Points to the item (10 Hit Points on a critical success). The resonant power allows you to cast [_mending_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1597) as an arcane innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Crescent) **Source** [Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun](/Sources.aspx?ID=259) pg. 79 **Price** 225 gp --- Once holy relics, the creation of _crescent aeon stones_ was inspired by [Acavna](/Deities.aspx?ID=402), goddess of the moon and protection. This is [silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2920) damage for the purposes of weaknesses, resistances, and the like. Aeon Stone (Vital amplification) **Source** [Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun](/Sources.aspx?ID=259) pg. 79 **Price** 330 gp --- A _vital amplification aeon stone_ improves the flow of vital energy through your body, speeding the healing process and safeguarding your body from life-draining effects. Whenever you regain Hit Points, you regain an additional 1 Hit Point for each 10 Hit Points regained (minimum 1 additional Hit Point). The resonant power grants you [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) 5 to void damage. Aeon Stone (Flickering) **Source** [Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun](/Sources.aspx?ID=259) pg. 79 **Price** 1,200 gp --- A _flickering aeon stone_ contains a drop of orichalcum at its center. It remains slightly out of phase with reality, giving it a translucent appearance. **Activate—Flicker** ; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The _flickering aeon stone_ draws you slightly out of sync with the flow of time, causing you to flicker in and out of existence. You become [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) for 1 minute, but you can’t use this concealment to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) or [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=2405). **Activate—Enter Stasis** ; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The _flickering aeon stone_ pulls you from the flow of time completely, placing you in temporary stasis while you heal, then returning you to reality at the moment you left. You regain 2d10+8 Hit Points. If you have the [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61), [drained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68), [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71), or [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) condition, the value of each of these conditions is reduced by 1. The resonant power grants you a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls. Aeon Stone (Eastern Star) **Source** [The Dead God's Hand](/Sources.aspx?ID=370) pg. 143 **Price** 350 gp --- This red crystal is cut in the shape of a five-pointed star. An _eastern star aeon stone_ must be activated to provide a benefit. The _eastern star aeon stone_ becomes infused with this language, granting you the ability to understand, speak, and write that language. This activation persists until you activate it again. Aeon Stone (Western Star) **Source** [The Dead God's Hand](/Sources.aspx?ID=370) pg. 143 **Price** 150 gp --- This blue crystal is cut in the shape of a five-pointed star. A _western star aeon stone_ must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +1 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38) checks. **Activate—Illusory Disguise** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The _western star aeon stone_ casts a 1st-rank [illusory disguise](/Spells.aspx?ID=1568) to your specifications. text: Item 1+ Aeon Stone Uncommon Invested Magical Source GM Core pg. 284 Usage worn Over millennia, these mysterious, intricately cut gemstones have been hoarded by mystics and fanatics hoping to discover their secrets. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to construct the universe in primeval times. When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an aeon stone with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful Disarm action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are suppressed until you return it to orbit your head again. There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into a special magical item called a wayfinder Item 16 Aeon Stone (Amplifying) Source GM Core pg. 284 Price 9,750 gp An amplifying aeon stone must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +2 item bonus to Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion checks—whichever corresponds to the tradition of the last spell you enhanced with this aeon stone. Activate—Amplify Single Action (concentrate, spellshape) Effect If your next action is to Cast a Spell, that spell's rank is 1 higher (maximum 10th rank) for the purposes of counteracting and being counteracted. Item 1 Aeon Stone (Consumed) Source GM Core pg. 284 Price 9 gp A consumed aeon stone is a dull lump that has lost its magical properties. It still rotates your head like any other aeon stone and can thus serve as a stylish, hand-free option for various spells that target an object. This aeon stone has no resonant power. Item 7 Aeon Stone (Delaying) Source GM Core pg. 284 Price 350 gp When you would die from the dying condition (typically at dying 4), this smooth pink stone automatically activates and reduces your dying value to 1 less than would normally kill you (typically to dying 3). The stone then permanently turns into a consumed aeon stone . You can benefit from this ability only once per day, even if you have multiple such stones. The resonant power allows you to cast 1st-rank heal as a divine innate spell once per day. Item 8 Aeon Stone (Envisioning) Source GM Core pg. 284 Price 425 gp This clear cube allows you to communicate with a limited form of telepathy to a range of 100 feet. The messages are transmitted as a simple image each round. These images are the quality of a hasty or childish sketch but can be roughly understood by creatures regardless of language. This provides no special ability to respond to your images. The resonant power allows you to cast translate as an occult innate spell once per day. Item 16 Aeon Stone (Peering) Source GM Core pg. 284 Price 9,500 gp This faintly colored prism catches and transforms light. If the aeon stone is in an area of bright light, shades of purple light provide dim light in a 30-foot radius. In that radius, magical items and effects are tinged with purple, the depth of the color revealing their counteract rank. The GM also secretly rolls a counteract check against any darkness or illusion effect the light touches. It has a counteract modifier of +25. If the light fails to counteract an effect, it won't try again for 24 hours. Inside a wayfinder , the aeon stone cannot catch light. However, its resonant power lets you activate or deactivate the aeon stone's light emitting from the wayfinder as an Interact action. Item 7 Aeon Stone (Nourishing) Source GM Core pg. 284 Price 325 gp After you've invested and worn this transparent stone for a week continuously, you no longer need to eat or drink. This time resets if you remove the aeon stone or it's invested by someone else. The resonant power allows you to cast air bubble as a primal innate spell once per day. Item 5 Aeon Stone (Preserving) Source GM Core pg. 284 Price 150 gp This red crystalline star covers you in a faint aura when you are subject to lingering wounds. You gain resistance 3 to persistent damage. At the end of any turn where the persistent damage can't overcome this resistance, end that condition. The resonant power allows you to cast stabilize as a primal innate cantrip. Item 7 Aeon Stone (Smoothing) Source GM Core pg. 284 Price 310 gp This spherical piece of silvery stone helps you ignore minor issues. You can ignore status penalties to skill checks from clumsy, enfeebled, frightened, sickened, and stupefied conditions as long as the value of that condition is 1. Its resonant power allows you to cast guidance as an occult innate cantrip. Item 6 Aeon Stone (Sprouting) Source GM Core pg. 284 Price 220 gp Encouraging the natural growth of life, this green ovoid can often be found surrounded by new seedlings. Its resonant power allows you to cast tangle vine as a primal innate cantrip. Activate—Flow of Life Reaction (concentrate, vitality) Frequency once per hour; Trigger You are healed by a vitality efect or took void damage; Effect You gain 8 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute. Item 4 Aeon Stone (Formulating) Source Pathfinder #213: Thirst for Blood pg. 81 Price 75 gp This four-sided prism is imbued with knowledge for the construction of several objects. The stone contains the knowledge of all formulas found in a basic crafter’s book. While you have the stone invested, you have the full knowledge of the stone’s formulas. This counts as having the formula for the purposes of Crafting checks. While you have this knowledge, you can write the formulas down for later use, such as if you lose access to the stone. You also gain a +1 item bonus to skill checks made to Craft while the stone is invested. The resonant power allows you to cast phantasmal minion as an arcane innate spell once per day. Item 4 Aeon Stone (Repairing) Source Pathfinder #213: Thirst for Blood pg. 82 Price 75 gp This translucent, spherical stone’s center contains a multitude of sparkling, colored flecks. The resonant power allows you to cast mending as an arcane innate spell once per day. Item 6 Aeon Stone (Crescent) Source Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun pg. 79 Price 225 gp Once holy relics, the creation of crescent aeon stones was inspired by Acavna, goddess of the moon and protection. Activate—Flicker Single Action ; Frequency once per day; Effect The flickering aeon stone draws you slightly out of sync with the flow of time, causing you to flicker in and out of existence. Activate—Enter Stasis Single Action ; Frequency once per day; Effect The flickering aeon stone pulls you from the flow of time completely, placing you in temporary stasis while you heal, then returning you to reality at the moment you left. The resonant power grants you a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls. Item 7 Aeon Stone (Eastern Star) Source The Dead God's Hand pg. 143 Price 350 gp This red crystal is cut in the shape of a five-pointed star. An eastern star aeon stone must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks. Activate—Absorb Language Two Actions (concentrate, manipulate) Frequency once per day; Effect You touch a creature who spoke a common language in your presence within the previous minute. The eastern star aeon stone becomes infused with this language, granting you the ability to understand, speak, and write that language. This activation persists until you activate it again. Item 3 Aeon Stone (Western Star) Source The Dead God's Hand pg. 143 Price 150 gp This blue crystal is cut in the shape of a five-pointed star. A western star aeon stone must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +1 item bonus to Deception checks. Activate—Illusory Disguise Two Actions (concentrate, illusion, manipulate, visual) Frequency once per day; Effect The western star aeon stone casts a 1st-rank illusory disguise to your specifications. If you so choose, the disguise obscures any aeon stones orbiting your head, rendering them invisible until the activation ends.

Item 5 Aeon Stone (Preserving) Source GM Core pg. 284 Price 150 gp This red crystalline star covers you in a faint aura when you are subject to lingering wounds. You gain resistance 3 to persistent damage. At the end of any turn where the persistent damage can't overcome this resistance, end that condition. The resonant power allows you to cast stabilize as a primal innate cantrip. Item 7 Aeon Stone (Smoothing) Source GM Core pg. 284 Price 310 gp This spherical piece of silvery stone helps you ignore minor issues. You can ignore status penalties to skill checks from clumsy, enfeebled, frightened, sickened, and stupefied conditions as long as the value of that condition is 1. Its resonant power allows you to cast guidance as an occult innate cantrip. Item 6 Aeon Stone (Sprouting) Source GM Core pg. 284 Price 220 gp Encouraging the natural growth of life, this green ovoid can often be found surrounded by new seedlings. Its resonant power allows you to cast tangle vine as a primal innate cantrip. Activate—Flow of Life Reaction (concentrate, vitality) Frequency once per hour; Trigger You are healed by a vitality efect or took void damage; Effect You gain 8 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute. Item 4 Aeon Stone (Formulating) Source Pathfinder #213: Thirst for Blood pg. 81 Price 75 gp This four-sided prism is imbued with knowledge for the construction of several objects. The stone contains the knowledge of all formulas found in a basic crafter’s book. While you have the stone invested, you have the full knowledge of the stone’s formulas. This counts as having the formula for the purposes of Crafting checks. While you have this knowledge, you can write the formulas down for later use, such as if you lose access to the stone. You also gain a +1 item bonus to skill checks made to Craft while the stone is invested. The resonant power allows you to cast phantasmal minion as an arcane innate spell once per day. Item 4 Aeon Stone (Repairing) Source Pathfinder #213: Thirst for Blood pg. 82 Price 75 gp This translucent, spherical stone’s center contains a multitude of sparkling, colored flecks. While you have this stone invested, you gain a +1 item bonus to skill checks made to Craft. Additionally, when Repairing an item, you restore an additional 5 Hit Points to the item (10 Hit Points on a critical success). The resonant power allows you to cast mending as an arcane innate spell once per day. Item 6 Aeon Stone (Crescent) Source Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun pg. 79 Price 225 gp Once holy relics, the creation of crescent aeon stones was inspired by Acavna, goddess of the moon and protection. Item 7 Aeon Stone (Vital amplification) Source Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun pg. 79 Price 330 gp A vital amplification aeon stone improves the flow of vital energy through your body, speeding the healing process and safeguarding your body from life-draining effects. This provides no special ability to respond to your images.
The resonant power allows you to cast [_translate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1723) as an occult innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Peering) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 9,500 gp --- This faintly colored prism catches and transforms light. If the _aeon stone_ is in an area of bright light, shades of purple light provide dim light in a 30-foot radius. In that radius, magical items and effects are tinged with purple, the depth of the color revealing their [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) rank.
The GM also secretly rolls a counteract check against any darkness or illusion effect the light touches. It has a counteract modifier of +25. If the light fails to counteract an effect, it won't try again for 24 hours.
Inside a _wayfinder_, the aeon stone cannot catch light. However, its resonant power lets you activate or deactivate the aeon stone's light emitting from the _wayfinder_ as an Interact action. Aeon Stone (Nourishing) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 325 gp --- After you've invested and worn this transparent stone for a week continuously, you no longer need to eat or drink. This time resets if you remove the _aeon stone_ or it's invested by someone else. The resonant power allows you to cast [_air bubble_](/Spells.aspx?ID=5) as a primal innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Preserving) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 150 gp --- This red crystalline star covers you in a faint aura when you are subject to lingering wounds. You gain resistance 3 to [persistent damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). At the end of any turn where the persistent damage can't overcome this resistance, end that condition.
The resonant power allows you to cast [_stabilize_](/Spells.aspx?ID=307) as a primal innate cantrip. Aeon Stone (Smoothing) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 310 gp --- This spherical piece of silvery stone helps you ignore minor issues. You can ignore status penalties to skill checks from [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=3), [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13), [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19), [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34), and [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37) conditions as long as the value of that condition is 1. Its resonant power allows you to cast [_guidance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=142) as an occult innate cantrip. Aeon Stone (Sprouting) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 220 gp --- Encouraging the natural growth of life, this green ovoid can often be found surrounded by new seedlings. Its resonant power allows you to cast [_tangle vine_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1713) as a primal innate cantrip. **Activate—Flow of Life** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [vitality](/Traits.aspx?ID=509)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You are healed by a vitality efect or took void damage; **Effect** You gain 8 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute. Aeon Stone (Formulating) **Source** [Pathfinder #213: Thirst for Blood](/Sources.aspx?ID=257) pg. 81 **Price** 75 gp --- This four-sided prism is imbued with knowledge for the construction of several objects. The stone contains the knowledge of all formulas found in a basic crafter’s book. While you have the stone [invested](/Traits.aspx?ID=637), you have the full knowledge of the stone’s formulas. This counts as having the formula for the purposes of [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=37) checks. While you have this knowledge, you can write the formulas down for later use, such as if you lose access to the stone. You also gain a +1 item bonus to skill checks made to [Craft](/Actions.aspx?ID=2385) while the stone is invested. The resonant power allows you to cast [_phantasmal minion_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1631) as an arcane innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Repairing) **Source** [Pathfinder #213: Thirst for Blood](/Sources.aspx?ID=257) pg. 82 **Price** 75 gp --- This translucent, spherical stone’s center contains a multitude of sparkling, colored flecks. While you have this stone [invested](/Traits.aspx?ID=637), you gain a +1 item bonus to skill checks made to Craft. Additionally, when Repairing an item, you restore an additional 5 Hit Points to the item (10 Hit Points on a critical success). The resonant power allows you to cast [_mending_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1597) as an arcane innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Crescent) **Source** [Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun](/Sources.aspx?ID=259) pg. 79 **Price** 225 gp --- Once holy relics, the creation of _crescent aeon stones_ was inspired by [Acavna](/Deities.aspx?ID=402), goddess of the moon and protection. The _crescent aeon stone_ continually sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius. This is [silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2920) damage for the purposes of weaknesses, resistances, and the like. Aeon Stone (Vital amplification) **Source** [Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun](/Sources.aspx?ID=259) pg. 79 **Price** 330 gp --- A _vital amplification aeon stone_ improves the flow of vital energy through your body, speeding the healing process and safeguarding your body from life-draining effects. Whenever you regain Hit Points, you regain an additional 1 Hit Point for each 10 Hit Points regained (minimum 1 additional Hit Point). The resonant power grants you [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) 5 to void damage. Aeon Stone (Flickering) **Source** [Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun](/Sources.aspx?ID=259) pg. 79 **Price** 1,200 gp --- A _flickering aeon stone_ contains a drop of orichalcum at its center. It remains slightly out of phase with reality, giving it a translucent appearance. **Activate—Flicker** ; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The _flickering aeon stone_ draws you slightly out of sync with the flow of time, causing you to flicker in and out of existence. You become [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) for 1 minute, but you can’t use this concealment to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) or [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=2405). **Activate—Enter Stasis** ; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The _flickering aeon stone_ pulls you from the flow of time completely, placing you in temporary stasis while you heal, then returning you to reality at the moment you left. You regain 2d10+8 Hit Points. If you have the [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61), [drained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68), [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71), or [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) condition, the value of each of these conditions is reduced by 1. The resonant power grants you a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls. Aeon Stone (Eastern Star) **Source** [The Dead God's Hand](/Sources.aspx?ID=370) pg. 143 **Price** 350 gp --- This red crystal is cut in the shape of a five-pointed star. An _eastern star aeon stone_ must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +1 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) checks. **Activate—Absorb Language** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You touch a creature who spoke a common language in your presence within the previous minute. The _eastern star aeon stone_ becomes infused with this language, granting you the ability to understand, speak, and write that language. This activation persists until you activate it again. Aeon Stone (Western Star) **Source** [The Dead God's Hand](/Sources.aspx?ID=370) pg. 143 **Price** 150 gp --- This blue crystal is cut in the shape of a five-pointed star. A _western star aeon stone_ must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +1 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38) checks. **Activate—Illusory Disguise** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The _western star aeon stone_ casts a 1st-rank [illusory disguise](/Spells.aspx?ID=1568) to your specifications. text: Item 1+ Aeon Stone Uncommon Invested Magical Source GM Core pg. 284 Usage worn Over millennia, these mysterious, intricately cut gemstones have been hoarded by mystics and fanatics hoping to discover their secrets. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to construct the universe in primeval times. When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an aeon stone with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful Disarm action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are suppressed until you return it to orbit your head again. There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into a special magical item called a wayfinder Item 16 Aeon Stone (Amplifying) Source GM Core pg. 284 Price 9,750 gp An amplifying aeon stone must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +2 item bonus to Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion checks—whichever corresponds to the tradition of the last spell you enhanced with this aeon stone. Activate—Amplify Single Action (concentrate, spellshape) Effect If your next action is to Cast a Spell, that spell's rank is 1 higher (maximum 10th rank) for the purposes of counteracting and being counteracted. Item 1 Aeon Stone (Consumed) Source GM Core pg. 284 Price 9 gp A consumed aeon stone is a dull lump that has lost its magical properties. It still rotates your head like any other aeon stone and can thus serve as a stylish, hand-free option for various spells that target an object. This aeon stone has no resonant power. Item 7 Aeon Stone (Delaying) Source GM Core pg. 284 Price 350 gp When you would die from the dying condition (typically at dying 4), this smooth pink stone automatically activates and reduces your dying value to 1 less than would normally kill you (typically to dying 3). The stone then permanently turns into a consumed aeon stone . You can benefit from this ability only once per day, even if you have multiple such stones. The resonant power allows you to cast 1st-rank heal as a divine innate spell once per day. Item 8 Aeon Stone (Envisioning) Source GM Core pg. 284 Price 425 gp This clear cube allows you to communicate with a limited form of telepathy to a range of 100 feet. The messages are transmitted as a simple image each round. These images are the quality of a hasty or childish sketch but can be roughly understood by creatures regardless of language. This provides no special ability to respond to your images. The resonant power allows you to cast translate as an occult innate spell once per day. Item 16 Aeon Stone (Peering) Source GM Core pg. 284 Price 9,500 gp This faintly colored prism catches and transforms light. If the aeon stone is in an area of bright light, shades of purple light provide dim light in a 30-foot radius. In that radius, magical items and effects are tinged with purple, the depth of the color revealing their counteract rank. The GM also secretly rolls a counteract check against any darkness or illusion effect the light touches. It has a counteract modifier of +25. If the light fails to counteract an effect, it won't try again for 24 hours. Inside a wayfinder , the aeon stone cannot catch light. However, its resonant power lets you activate or deactivate the aeon stone's light emitting from the wayfinder as an Interact action. Item 7 Aeon Stone (Nourishing) Source GM Core pg. 284 Price 325 gp After you've invested and worn this transparent stone for a week continuously, you no longer need to eat or drink. This time resets if you remove the aeon stone or it's invested by someone else. The resonant power allows you to cast air bubble as a primal innate spell once per day. Item 5 Aeon Stone (Preserving) Source GM Core pg. 284 Price 150 gp This red crystalline star covers you in a faint aura when you are subject to lingering wounds. You gain resistance 3 to persistent damage. At the end of any turn where the persistent damage can't overcome this resistance, end that condition. The resonant power allows you to cast stabilize as a primal innate cantrip. Item 7 Aeon Stone (Smoothing) Source GM Core pg. 284 Price 310 gp This spherical piece of silvery stone helps you ignore minor issues. You can ignore status penalties to skill checks from clumsy, enfeebled, frightened, sickened, and stupefied conditions as long as the value of that condition is 1. Its resonant power allows you to cast guidance as an occult innate cantrip. Item 6 Aeon Stone (Sprouting) Source GM Core pg. 284 Price 220 gp Encouraging the natural growth of life, this green ovoid can often be found surrounded by new seedlings. Its resonant power allows you to cast tangle vine as a primal innate cantrip. Activate—Flow of Life Reaction (concentrate, vitality) Frequency once per hour; Trigger You are healed by a vitality efect or took void damage; Effect You gain 8 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute. Item 4 Aeon Stone (Formulating) Source Pathfinder #213: Thirst for Blood pg. 81 Price 75 gp This four-sided prism is imbued with knowledge for the construction of several objects. The stone contains the knowledge of all formulas found in a basic crafter’s book. While you have the stone invested, you have the full knowledge of the stone’s formulas. This counts as having the formula for the purposes of Crafting checks. While you have this knowledge, you can write the formulas down for later use, such as if you lose access to the stone. You also gain a +1 item bonus to skill checks made to Craft while the stone is invested. The resonant power allows you to cast phantasmal minion as an arcane innate spell once per day. Item 4 Aeon Stone (Repairing) Source Pathfinder #213: Thirst for Blood pg. 82 Price 75 gp This translucent, spherical stone’s center contains a multitude of sparkling, colored flecks. While you have this stone invested, you gain a +1 item bonus to skill checks made to Craft. Additionally, when Repairing an item, you restore an additional 5 Hit Points to the item (10 Hit Points on a critical success). The resonant power allows you to cast mending as an arcane innate spell once per day. Item 6 Aeon Stone (Crescent) Source Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun pg. 79 Price 225 gp Once holy relics, the creation of crescent aeon stones was inspired by Acavna, goddess of the moon and protection. The crescent aeon stone continually sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius. The resonant power enables you to cast forbidding ward as a divine innate cantrip. Activate—Moonbeam Two Actions (concentrate, divine, holy, light, spirit) Frequency once per day; Effect The crescent aeon stone fires a blast of silvery moonlight in a 100-foot line, dealing 4d12 spirit damage to all creatures in the area (DC 22 basic Reflex save). This is silver damage for the purposes of weaknesses, resistances, and the like. Item 7 Aeon Stone (Vital amplification) Source Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun pg. 79 Price 330 gp A vital amplification aeon stone improves the flow of vital energy through your body, speeding the healing process and safeguarding your body from life-draining effects. Whenever you regain Hit Points, you regain an additional 1 Hit Point for each 10 Hit Points regained (minimum 1 additional Hit Point). The resonant power grants you resistance 5 to void damage. Item 11 Aeon Stone (Flickering) Source Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun pg. 79 Price 1,200 gp A flickering aeon stone contains a drop of orichalcum at its center. It remains slightly out of phase with reality, giving it a translucent appearance. Activate—Flicker Single Action ; Frequency once per day; Effect The flickering aeon stone draws you slightly out of sync with the flow of time, causing you to flicker in and out of existence. You become concealed for 1 minute, but you can’t use this concealment to Hide or Sneak. Activate—Enter Stasis Single Action ; Frequency once per day; Effect The flickering aeon stone pulls you from the flow of time completely, placing you in temporary stasis while you heal, then returning you to reality at the moment you left. You regain 2d10+8 Hit Points. If you have the clumsy, drained, enfeebled, or stupefied condition, the value of each of these conditions is reduced by 1. The resonant power grants you a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls. Item 7 Aeon Stone (Eastern Star) Source The Dead God's Hand pg. 143 Price 350 gp This red crystal is cut in the shape of a five-pointed star. An eastern star aeon stone must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks. Activate—Absorb Language Two Actions (concentrate, manipulate) Frequency once per day; Effect You touch a creature who spoke a common language in your presence within the previous minute. The eastern star aeon stone becomes infused with this language, granting you the ability to understand, speak, and write that language. This activation persists until you activate it again. Item 3 Aeon Stone (Western Star) Source The Dead God's Hand pg. 143 Price 150 gp This blue crystal is cut in the shape of a five-pointed star. A western star aeon stone must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +1 item bonus to Deception checks. Activate—Illusory Disguise Two Actions (concentrate, illusion, manipulate, visual) Frequency once per day; Effect The western star aeon stone casts a 1st-rank illusory disguise to your specifications. If you so choose, the disguise obscures any aeon stones orbiting your head, rendering them invisible until the activation ends.

Additionally, when Repairing an item, you restore an additional 5 Hit Points to the item (10 Hit Points on a critical success). The resonant power allows you to cast mending as an arcane innate spell once per day. Item 6 Aeon Stone (Crescent) Source Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun pg. 79 Price 225 gp Once holy relics, the creation of crescent aeon stones was inspired by Acavna, goddess of the moon and protection. The crescent aeon stone continually sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius. The resonant power enables you to cast forbidding ward as a divine innate cantrip. Activate—Moonbeam Two Actions (concentrate, divine, holy, light, spirit) Frequency once per day; Effect The crescent aeon stone fires a blast of silvery moonlight in a 100-foot line, dealing 4d12 spirit damage to all creatures in the area (DC 22 basic Reflex save). This is silver damage for the purposes of weaknesses, resistances, and the like. Item 7 Aeon Stone (Vital amplification) Source Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun pg. 79 Price 330 gp A vital amplification aeon stone improves the flow of vital energy through your body, speeding the healing process and safeguarding your body from life-draining effects. Whenever you regain Hit Points, you regain an additional 1 Hit Point for each 10 Hit Points regained (minimum 1 additional Hit Point). The resonant power grants you resistance 5 to void damage. Item 11 Aeon Stone (Flickering) Source Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun pg. 79 Price 1,200 gp A flickering aeon stone contains a drop of orichalcum at its center. It remains slightly out of phase with reality, giving it a translucent appearance. Activate—Flicker Single Action ; Frequency once per day; Effect The flickering aeon stone draws you slightly out of sync with the flow of time, causing you to flicker in and out of existence. You become concealed for 1 minute, but you can’t use this concealment to Hide or Sneak. Activate—Enter Stasis Single Action ; Frequency once per day; Effect The flickering aeon stone pulls you from the flow of time completely, placing you in temporary stasis while you heal, then returning you to reality at the moment you left. You regain 2d10+8 Hit Points. If you have the clumsy, drained, enfeebled, or stupefied condition, the value of each of these conditions is reduced by 1. The resonant power grants you a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls. Item 7 Aeon Stone (Eastern Star) Source The Dead God's Hand pg. 143 Price 350 gp This red crystal is cut in the shape of a five-pointed star. An eastern star aeon stone must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks. Activate—Absorb Language Two Actions (concentrate, manipulate) Frequency once per day; Effect You touch a creature who spoke a common language in your presence within the previous minute. The eastern star aeon stone becomes infused with this language, granting you the ability to understand, speak, and write that language. This activation persists until you activate it again. Item 3 Aeon Stone (Western Star) Source The Dead God's Hand pg. 143 Price 150 gp This blue crystal is cut in the shape of a five-pointed star. A western star aeon stone must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +1 item bonus to Deception checks. Activate—Illusory Disguise Two Actions (concentrate, illusion, manipulate, visual) Frequency once per day; Effect The western star aeon stone casts a 1st-rank illusory disguise to your specifications. If you so choose, the disguise obscures any aeon stones orbiting your head, rendering them invisible until the activation ends.

text: Item 10 Charlatan's Cape Uncommon Invested Magical Source GM Core pg. 286 Price 980 gp Usage worn cloak Bulk L This bright red-and-gold cape is often interlaced with glittery threads and serves as a distraction. While wearing the cape, you gain a +2 item bonus to Deception checks. Activate—Puff of Smoke Two Actions (manipulate) Frequency once per day; Effect You cast translocate . The space you leave and the one you appear in are filled with puffs of smoke that make anyone within concealed until they leave the smoke or the end of your next turn, at which point the smoke dissipates. Strong winds immediately disperse the smoke.

---

This platinum choker bears characters from a language's alphabet, and it gives knowledge of that language and the associated culture's customs. You gain a +1 item bonus to Society checks and the ability to understand, speak, and write the chosen language. Your excellent elocution reduces the DC of the flat check to perform an auditory action while deafened from 5 to 3.  

**Craft Requirements** You know the language or languages the choker grants.

[Clandestine Cloak](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3067)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 287

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cloak

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

When you pull up the hood of this nondescript gray cloak (an Interact action), you become drab and uninteresting, gaining a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks and to Deception checks to Impersonate a forgettable background character, such as a servant, but also taking a –1 item penalty to Diplomacy and Intimidation checks. 

**Activate—Cloak Identity** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You pull the cloak's hood up and gain the benefits of [_veil of privacy_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1739) for 1 hour or until you pull the hood back down, whichever comes first.

</column>

</title>

**Price** 230 gp

</row>

</column>

</title>

</traits>

**Price** 900 gp

</row>

</column>

---

The item bonus is +2, and when you activate the cloak, you gain the benefits of 5th-rank [_veil of privacy_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1739) for 8 hours.

The boots grant you a +2 item bonus to Acrobatics checks and a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to Tumble Through an enemy's space.
The boots can grip solid surfaces and help you avoid a fall, allowing you to use the Grab an Edge reaction even if your hands aren't free. You treat falls as 10 feet shorter or, if you have the Cat Fall feat, treat your proficiency rank in Acrobatics as one degree better to determine the benefits of that feat. If you have Cat Fall and are already legendary in Acrobatics, you can choose the speed of your fall, from 60 feet per round up to normal falling speed. The boots can be activated. **Activate—Daredevil Impulse** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The boots cast [_unfettered movement_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1732) on you.

These vestments are made of panels showing various scenes from the legends of a particular deity. It serves as a religious symbol of that deity, and you gain a +2 item bonus to Religion checks. When you cast [_harm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=146) or [_heal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=148), healing granted to followers of that deity is increased by the rank of the spell.

**Craft Requirements** You are a cleric who worships the deity tied to the vestments.

**Craft Requirements** You are a bard.

These clean, white gloves never show signs of blood, even after they're used to stitch up wounds or treat other ailments. They give you a +1 item bonus to Medicine checks.

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 290 **Usage** worn --- Fine silk lines this fashionable pocket, which is typically cinched to a belt or tailored into a piece of formal clothing. The pocket can hold no more than one item of light Bulk, plus incidental items of negligible Bulk. The pocket grants you a +2 item bonus to Society and to Stealth checks to [Conceal an Object](/Actions.aspx?ID=61) in the pocket.
The pocket can produce stationery and writing implements of high quality. When you [Create a Forgery](/Actions.aspx?ID=60), you can use the pocket to produce ideal materials to make the forgery. Any materials must be able to fit through the opening of the pocket, such as a roll of parchment, an inkwell, or a loupe. Though they're excellent tools, they don't have any value if sold and disappear once their function in making a forgery is fulfilled. **Activate—Papers Please** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Effect** You create a temporary forgery by imagining the document you need and pulling it from the pocket. Attempt to [Create a Forgery](/Actions.aspx?ID=60) of the document you desire, with the GM rolling the secret check as normal. Its quality is based on your check, but the document disintegrates after 1 hour. Humbug Pocket **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 290 **Price** 650 gp Humbug Pocket (Greater) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 290 **Price** 12,500 gp --- The item bonus is +3. You can forge up to five documents with Papers Please, but they must serve a similar purpose— five invitations to the same party for different attendees, for example. Attempt only one check for all the documents.

markdown:
**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 291 **Price** 19,000 gp **Usage** worn garment **Bulk** 2 --- This strange and intricate harness fits snugly to the torso. Once you invest the apparatus, numerous artificial limbs with various tools, clamps, and lenses whirl into action, following your mental commands effortlessly.
When using this apparatus, you gain a +3 item bonus to Crafting checks to [Craft](/Actions.aspx?ID=43), [Earn Income](/Actions.aspx?ID=23), and [Repair](/Actions.aspx?ID=42), and you reduce the minimum time required to Craft an item to 1 day. If you succeed at your Crafting check and spend more downtime to continue work on the item after the minimum number of days, each day you spend reduces the remaining raw material cost by an amount based on your level + 1 and your proficiency rank in Crafting; on a critical success, each day reduces the remaining raw material cost by an amount based on your level + 2 and your proficiency rank. If you are 20th level, on a critical success your progress is 50 gp, 100 gp, 200 gp, or 350 gp for trained, expert, master, or legendary proficiency, respectively. **Activate—Inexplicable Patch** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You command the apparatus to magically jury-rig an item you hold or that's within 5 feet of you. The item is repaired, as a 3rd-rank [_mending_](/Spells.aspx?ID=189) spell. This lasts for 10 minutes, after which the item returns to its previous state of disrepair unless you've Repaired it before then.
name: Inexplicable Apparatus

You can carry Bulk equal to 6 + your Strength modifier before becoming encumbered, and you can hold and carry a total Bulk up to 11 + your Strength modifier. Activate—Assisted Lift Two Actions (manipulate) Effect You lift an object of up to 8 Bulk as though it were weightless. This requires two hands, and if the object is locked or otherwise held in place, you can attempt to Force it Open using Athletics as part of this activation. The object still has its full weight and Bulk for all other purposes—you just ignore that weight. The effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

<traits>

<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
<trait label="Mental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=647" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 292

**Price** 500 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn gloves

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These white silk gloves are adorned in red hearts that glow faintly whenever you are adjacent to someone you feel particularly strongly toward. They buoy your spirit, giving you a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks. 

**Activate—Bond** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You grasp the hands of a willing creature you have strong positive feelings about, regardless of the nature of those feelings. The creature gains a +1 status bonus to saving throws and 10 temporary Hit Points for 10 minutes. If the creature shares your feelings, you gain the same benefits, and for the duration, when you both roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect that causes negative emotions, you both get a critical success instead.

</column>

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 294

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This sprig of berry-festooned holly and mistletoe doesn't wilt or rot. It can be used as a primal locus, and it grants a +1 item bonus to Nature checks while you wear it. 

**Activate—Anoint** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per 10 minutes;   **Effect** You squeeze juice from one of the berries and smear it onto a weapon made primarily of wood to cast [_runic weapon_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1658) on it, or onto a creature to cast [_runic body_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1657) on it. 

**Activate—Bind** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You touch the sprig, then a tree to cast [_one with plants_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1618) upon yourself, turning into a vine on the touched tree.

</column>

</traits>
